body:
My experience, an experience that changed my life.  To this day, Im still not sure what I experienced, but I know the experience came directly from Albuterol.
The year was 1998 (when I was 14 - I'm 30 now), on a Monday. At this time in my life I was attending a new school and really didn't have many friends.  I was a loner by choice, and didnt really have what some people might call a childhood friend.  At the time I was suffering from asthma.   I pretty much outgrew it, but would occasionally need it [albuterol] if I caught a cold.
It was a monday morning around 7 am maybe, Im not sure the exact time.  But I remember hearing smooth jazz playing on the radio, as I always slept with the radio on.  I came to the point in my life in which you could say I was semi-suicidal.  But lets just say I had some issues with school.  I heard in the past that if a certain amount of puffs were taken a person could kill themselves from Albuterol overdose.   Im assuming cardiac arrest would follow, because inhalers do increase the heart rate.
So I get up and look down at my feet and I see my inhaler.  I pick it up and take maybe 13 puffs.  I did not inhale each puff separately, but 13 puffs being sure to hold it in my mouth, and all at once inhale.  Immediately after this I took another 7-10 puffs.
As soon as I exhaled, my body began to tingle all over.  Never in my life have I experienced such tingles, it felt more like a vibration and not a tingling sensation you get after your arm falls asleep.  Once I noticed my body tingling, I heard this beeping sound, that started very quietly and quickly increased in volume until the sound became deafening.    As soon as this sound reached its climax, I had this strange feeling that I knew everything, or as if I knew myself before knowing myself.  I cant explain it, but I knew it was over, and I killed myself.  I immediately tried to run out of my room.  Because by now Im panicking and Im sure its over.  As Im running Im screaming from the top of my lungs, but my voice is not high pitched but low pitched as it would sound if you slowed a recording down half speed.
Im running and running, but everything has slowed down, and everything in the room is turning yellow (meaning there is a yellowish light illuminating my room). From my bed to the door, was no more than 50 feet.  But while running time and space was not the same, it seemed as if the door was 500 feet away.  And off in the distance by the door I could see this candle burning on the floor, which was obviously a hallucination.  I finally made it to the door, and I see my mother at the bottom of the steps asking me whats wrong.  Again sound was distorted so her voice sounded more like an echo, and the colors of the carpet were bright and lively.  But I saw no beauty in this, because I was terrified.
I ran down the stairs and hug my mother tightly, knowing this could possibly be the last time I hug her before I die.  While I was hugging her, I felt this strange presence.  Not really evil but something strange; at the time it felt sort of evil.  If I had to choose one word, I would say Death.  This presence hovered over me for a couple seconds, and the sound dissipated, the colors returned to normal and I felt as if my soul returned back into my body.
Im always impressed when people write in such great detail their experiences. Im not that good with my words, but even if I was I dont think I could really ever explain my experience.  For 16 years Ive only told maybe 3 people besides my parents. The reason being many, ranging from you had a bad dream Albuterol wont do that, to you were suicidal and under stress so you had a panic attack.  Excuse my french, but they can all go to hell, because Im 100% sure what I experienced was damn near real.  I feel as if this drug took me to another realm for a split second.  I could go on and on, but I wont.
[Reported Dose: ''22 puffs'']
